title: The Categorical and Geometric Structure of Subobject Lattices
description: Formal categorical and geometric study of subobject lattices and higher associativity, featuring a zero-sorry Lean 4 formalization. The project covers: (1) posets as thin categories, limits/colimits, idempotent monads, and signed modularity defects; (2) associahedra $K_n$, bracket-to-face order isomorphisms, Loday convex realizations, two-sided constructive equivalence between $A_n$ almost-positive roots, associahedron facets, and polygon chords, with $A_3$ specialization to 6 pentagons and 3 squares, and positive-definite discrete Dirichlet-Cartan quadratic forms; (3) path valuations into $(\mathbb{N}, +) \times \mathbf{U}_2(\mathbb{Z})$ on covering quivers, invariance under full bracketings, signed directed reassociation paths, pentagon obstruction, and transfinite Loewy filtrations in universe-stratified abelian categories; and (4) asymptotic operadic sub-tree embedding distributions, exact variance scaling, Aldous fringe laws, and boundary towers $K_N \hookrightarrow K_{N+1}$.
